T: Corn for Mum, cucumbers from the stream.
D: Two young sisters who move to the countryside befriend a giant forest spirit.
P: Serve the cucumbers when Granny pulls them out of the cold stream.
S: Granny's garden and the cold stream
Small cucumbers chilled in iced water, cut into spears and served with miso mixed with a little honey for dipping.
the corn Mei carries all the way to Mum
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with butter melted with soy sauce and a little sugar.
a country lunch on the porch
Warm short-grain rice shaped into triangles around a little salmon or pickled plum, wrapped in nori.
M: the lunch Satsuki packs for everyone
Rice with peas, pink fish flakes and a pickled plum, with teriyaki chicken, rolled omelette and pickles in a box.
waiting at the bus stop in the rain
Thick udon noodles in a hot dashi broth with spring onion, a soft egg and a few slices of fish cake.
W: a sweet for the forest walk
Little honey pancakes cooked golden in a pan, cooled, then sandwiched in pairs with sweet red bean paste.
K: Roasted barley tea brewed and chilled, poured over ice in tall glasses.

s.note: Granny's garden and the cold stream
s.how: Soak 6 small cucumbers in a bowl of iced water for 30 minutes, the way Granny cools them in the stream. Cut into spears. Mix 3 tbsp white miso with 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp water and serve in a little dish for dipping.

s.note: the corn Mei carries all the way to Mum
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Melt 40g butter with 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar and brush all over the corn while it's hot.

m.note: the lunch Satsuki packs for everyone
m.how: Cook 400g sushi rice. Fry 500g chicken thighs, then glaze with 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp sugar until sticky. Whisk 4 eggs with a pinch of sugar and roll into a thin omelette in a pan. Pack each box with rice topped with peas, sliced chicken, omelette and pickled ginger.

w.note: a sweet for the forest walk
w.how: Whisk 3 eggs with 100g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then 150g flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 60ml water. Cook 16 small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 1 minute a side. Sandwich in pairs with 300g red bean paste.

d.how: Steep 3 roasted barley tea bags in 1.5L just-boiled water for 10 minutes, then remove the bags and chill for 2 hours. Pour into 4 tall glasses over ice.
